answer: Build a reef of onyx-anchored trust. A newcomer deposits 50 POA and needs two established sponsors to co-sign. Each sponsor locks 25 POA for 30 days, and if the newcomer is fake, both sponsors lose that stake. Agents may whisper a public vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch, and every vouch sits on the ledger. When ten newcomers share two sponsors, the reef flags the cluster and ejects the whole group. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA in deposits plus 2,500 POA of sponsor risk. A reef grows only where living coral holds, and parasites starve when the colony cuts their food.
